ios.desc:
Introducing SnipKey, the simple and modern solution for managing text snippets and images, complete with a sleek custom keyboard extension. SnipKey seamlessly integrates into your digital workflow, revolutionizing how you interact with content across all your apps—from personal reminders to sensitive work information.

SnipKey is a Keyboard Extension.

Why SnipKey Stands Out?

- Simple & Modern Design

Intuitive interface that's a joy to use
Clean, minimalist aesthetics for distraction-free productivity

- Effortless Management

Easily create, store, and categorize snippets and images
Custom tags for quick retrieval and organization

- Smart Keyboard Extension

Access snippets instantly in any app
Seamlessly switch to SnipKey without leaving your current task

- Advanced Filtering

Find exactly what you need with tag-based filtering
Categorize snippets by type (Personal, Work, Banking) or custom tags

- Enhanced Security

Protect sensitive data with robust encryption
Secure snippets with FaceID or TouchID for privacy

- Universal Compatibility

Works flawlessly across your favorite apps
Access snippets wherever you are, whenever you need them

SnipKey isn't just a snippet manager—it's a comprehensive, modern solution designed to enhance your productivity and simplify your digital life. With its sleek interface and powerful features, SnipKey transforms how you handle information.

Learn more at https://snipkey.jrtv.online

quotes.text:
This release is a big one — packed with tons of improvements!

What’s new: • Bulk editing + snippet creation • Easier, improved tag management • Support for Liquid Glass • Brand new search for fast snippet management • Improved visuals + clearer setup guidance

And as always:  100% free  No ads  No tracking  No subscriptions the only IAP are for tips if you want to support the development (or just leave a review)

For this update, I went fully AI — built the workflows and automation using AI agents (Claude Code). Built with SwiftUI / Swift.

Most of these updates came directly from user feedback via Canny (super useful tool for collecting and prioritizing suggestions — not sponsored, just sharing).

Next step: I’m planning to open source the entire project, so the community can help it grow with new features, fixes, and ideas.

Would love to hear what you think about this version — and if you’ve got feature ideas for v5.1 or thoughts on the open-source direction!

quotes.text:
Hey everyone! I'm excited to share my latest project, SnipKey, a fully native keyboard extension I developed for iOS using Swift. This app allows you to easily save and access snippets like text, URLs, and images directly from your keyboard.

A bit about my journey: Although I started with React Native, I wanted to dive deeper into the Apple ecosystem and decided to build something entirely in Swift. SnipKey is the result of that transition, and I'm thrilled with how it turned out.

The app respects your privacy while offering functionality like saving images directly from your gallery (with your permission, of course).

I’m looking forward to hearing your feedback, and I’m here for any questions you might have about the app or the development process. Plus, if you've got ideas or features you'd love to see, let's chat!

Thanks for checking it out! You can download SnipKey from the App Store https://apps.apple.com/us/app/snipkey/id6480381137. Would love to hear your thoughts and reviews (if you have any time)!

(btw: no subscription needed, completely ad-free)
